{{Short description|Genus of grasses}} {{For|the gastropod subgenus|Conus (Gastridium)}} {{Automatic taxobox | image = Gastridium phleoides.jpg | image_caption = ''Gastridium phleoides'' | display_parents = 4 | taxon = Gastridium | authority = [[Palisot de Beauvois|P.Beauv.]] | type_species = ''[[Gastridium australe]]''
(syn. of ''G. ventricosum'') | type_species_authority = ([[Carl Linnaeus|L.]]) [[Palisot de Beauvois|P.Beauv.]] }} '''''Gastridium''''' is a genus of plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]]. Species of the genus are found in Africa and Eurasia.[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394100#page/105/mode/1up Palisot de Beauvois, Ambroise Marie François Joseph . 1812. Essai d'une Nouvelle Agrostographie 21, 164. ] in Latin[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394100#page/291/mode/1up Palisot de Beauvois, Ambroise Marie François Joseph . 1812. Essai d'une Nouvelle Agrostographie plate VI (6), figure VI (6 a-e) at upper right] line drawings of ''Gastridium australe'' (syn of ''G. ventricosum''); [https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394100#page/272/mode/1up figure captions on caption page 6] These grasses are sometimes called '''nit grass'''.[https://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Gastridium Altervista Flora Italiana, genere ''Gastridium'', nit grass] ; Species The following species are recognised in the genus ''Gastridium'':{{Cite web |title=Gastridium P.Beauv. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:18109-1 |access-date=2022-09-12 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}} * ''[[Gastridium lainzii]]'' (Romero García) Romero Zarco - south-western Spain * ''Gastridium phleoides'' (Nees & Meyen) C.E.Hubb. - Africa, southern Europe, [[Middle East]], [[Arabian Peninsula]] * ''[[Gastridium scabrum]]'' C.Presl - [[Mediterranean]] region * ''Gastridium ventricosum'' (Gouan) Schinz & Thell - Mediterranean and nearby regions from [[Great Britain]] to [[Cape Verde]] to [[Caucasus]] ; Formerly included[https://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=451533 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families] see ''[[Triplachne]]'' * ''Gastridium littorale - [[Triplachne nitens]]'' * ''Gastridium nitens - [[Triplachne nitens]]'' * ''Gastridium triaristatum - [[Triplachne nitens]]'' ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [https://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?8738,9031 Jepson Manual Treatment] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20110611140819/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Gastridium_phleoides&type=treatment Grass Manual Account] {{Taxonbar|from=Q2648955}} [[Category:Pooideae]] [[Category:Poaceae genera]] {{Pooideae-stub}}
